research_question: Can information fully available no later than the Shock Failure entry decision boundary distinguish continuation resumption from sustained reversal across 2023H1-2024H2?

model_contract.logistic: L2 logistic regression, C=0.5, balanced classes, median imputation, standardized predictors
model_contract.tree: decision tree depth <=2, minimum leaf 10, balanced classes
model_contract.rank: equal-weight monotonic score using training-only median, IQR and class-orientation
model_contract.outer_validation: Leave-One-Fold-Out across the four development folds
model_contract.threshold_selection: fixed grid selected inside the three training folds; the outer fold is never used to select its threshold
model_contract.final_freeze: one model family and one threshold may be frozen only from development OOF evidence and only if every portable gate passes

feature_timestamp_contract.m15: shock and failure bars must be completed
feature_timestamp_contract.m1_m5: only completed bars ending no later than entry_decision_utc
feature_timestamp_contract.h1_h4: only completed higher-timeframe bars; current incomplete bar is forbidden
feature_timestamp_contract.ticks: timestamp_utc < entry_decision_utc, except the executable entry tick is retained only in lifecycle/execution fields and never in candidate predictors
feature_timestamp_contract.post_entry_mfe_mae_pnl: labels and evaluation only, never predictors

stress_contract.threshold_neighborhood: selected threshold and adjacent fixed-grid thresholds
